_note: Reconstructions for FLUX.1-schnell - extinct animals and lost landscapes only. Living species (coelacanth, horseshoe crab, nautilus, tuatara, crocodile) are shown only in real photographs and footage (photos below, footage.json). Each prompt spells out the anatomy the species check (pipeline/speciescheck.py) then asks for, and describes the animal in its own terms only: FLUX draws whatever a prompt names, so a 'not like a bird' brings the bird in. Three seeds each; the first that passes the check is used. Anatomy after the Wikipedia articles Edmontosaurus, Quetzalcoatlus, Azhdarchidae, Eusthenopteron, Dunkleosteus, Cretaceous flora.
style: photorealistic wildlife documentary frame, BBC natural history cinematography, natural vivid colours, soft natural light, high dynamic range, sharp detail, 35mm film look, no text, no people

prompts.asteroid_sky: Late Cretaceous coastal plain at dusk, a blazing fireball with a long smoke trail streaking across a vast orange and violet sky, silhouettes of araucaria conifers and cycads on the horizon, calm sea reflecting the light, empty landscape, wide shot
prompts.impact_forest: Late Cretaceous conifer forest after the asteroid impact, glowing embers and ash falling through hazy orange light, burnt araucaria trunks, smoke drifting between trees, empty forest, wide shot
prompts.edmontosaurus_shore: a herd of Edmontosaurus, large hadrosaurid dinosaurs of the Late Cretaceous, each with a long low flat-topped head ending in a broad flat duck-like bill, no crest on the head, a short thick neck held low and level with the back, a bulky barrel-shaped body, a long heavy tail held straight out behind, pillar-like hind legs with three blunt hoof-like toes, smaller front legs; most graze on all fours, one stands on its hind legs; pebbly grey-green scaly skin; along a misty river delta at sunrise with ferns, horsetails and araucaria trees, wide shot
prompts.after_impact_dawn: pale cold dawn over a devastated Late Cretaceous landscape, charred standing tree trunks, the ground covered in grey ash with fresh green ferns sprouting, low fog, empty landscape, wide shot
prompts.devonian_sea: Devonian sea floor 380 million years ago, an Eusthenopteron swimming over the reef: a long slender torpedo-shaped fish with a pointed head, thick rounded scales, paired fleshy lobed fins with a bony stalk, and a symmetrical three-lobed tail with a small pointed middle lobe; behind it a Dunkleosteus, a huge armoured fish whose head and front body are covered by thick jointed bony plates and whose jaws are sharp self-sharpening bone blades instead of teeth; the reef built of stromatoporoid sponges, horn-shaped rugose corals and swaying crinoids, clear blue water with sunbeams
prompts.cretaceous_coast: Late Cretaceous coastline, tall white chalk cliffs above a turquoise sea, two giant Quetzalcoatlus pterosaurs gliding over the waves: each has an enormous straight pointed toothless beak as long as its body, a small bony crest on the back of the skull, a very long stiff neck held straight, a short compact body covered in fine short reddish fuzz, and huge wings of thin brown leathery skin stretched from one extremely long wing finger down to the ankles, small clawed fingers at the front of each wing, a tiny tail; golden afternoon light, wide shot
prompts.cretaceous_sunrise: sunrise over a calm Late Cretaceous lagoon, wet sand and shallow water in the foreground, cycads, tree ferns and araucaria conifers along the shore, mist on the water, warm golden light, empty shore, low angle wide shot
